Barbers - Paying up isnt the problem - & I come from top 10 U.S. cities w/highest cost of living. The problem is the talent - invest, expand, indulge - not on your game but on the art. No cut is same on every head, grain is different, way it grows differs, etc - you should know/understand the need. Now, all this is a 'u' problem , here is where your problem becomes client problem (to carry for the next weeks or months) - You simply arent to par. When it comes to schooling - books/teachings the same since 90s. 

But stop uploading videos showing how to this, how to that...its not the same for everyone.

Now to my dear colleagues 'the client' - understand that not every barber bothers with adding dexterity to their experience. Its like a steak - depending on the chef and quality - you will pay that top dollar - and this is for something that you eat and shortly after discard - so paying isnt the problem - find that barber and once you find that barber - pay up.
